agency_full: Astrobotic Technology (US commercial company), for NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services
payload: Peregrine lander, 1,283 kg at launch (Wikipedia); 20 payloads, five of them NASA instruments; never reached the Moon
credit: Astrobotic's Peregrine Mission One post-mission report (August 2024) for the launch, the propellant leak and the re-entry; NASA's CLPS press kit and Astrobotic's payload user guide for the planned mission; Spaceflight Now for the re-entry. The arrival date is the date of the controlled re-entry, because the lander never reached the Moon. Conflicts kept open: the report's narrative says '4 PM EST on January 19' for the re-entry but its summary and Spaceflight Now say 18 January, so 18 January is used; Wikipedia's 15:59 EST 'near Point Nemo' is not supported by the report or Spaceflight Now and is not used. Count: 20 payloads in the report, 21 in Astrobotic's launch packet. Dry mass, Isp, the planned site's coordinates, the rideshare list and the 17-versus-39-day lunar-orbit wording in NASA's press kit were not resolved. The launch mass is from Wikipedia only.
